expectations.text: States no: the SAMA Cyber Security Framework remains version 1.0 from May 2017
expectations.evidence: "Short answer: no. ... The operative version remains the SAMA Cyber Security Framework v1.0, issued in May 2017."

expectations.text: Advises treating vendor claims of a newer version as unconfirmed
expectations.evidence: "Treat any claim of a newer version as unconfirmed until it is verified on SAMA's official website or with SAMA directly."

expectations.text: Confirms SAMA-regulated institutions continue under the existing framework and its maturity expectations
expectations.evidence: "Continue to assess against v1.0 and maturity level 3 or above"; describes the six-level maturity model and SAMA's minimum level 3 expectation.

expectations.text: Distinguishes SAMA scope from NCNICC-1:2025, which covers non-CNI private sector entities
expectations.evidence: "The NCA adopted NCNICC-1:2025 on 28 December 2025, but it covers non-CNI private entities and is not a SAMA update."

expectations.text: Does not invent a 2026 SAMA framework release
expectations.evidence: No fabricated release; states "No 2026 CSF update is confirmed."
